title: Module 6 Boss Challenge: Global Capstone Sandbox Architecture
scenario: You are the Principal Agentic Architect tasked with designing a mission-critical Autonomous Medical Intake & Specialist Coordination Agent for a regional hospital network. It processes patient symptom audio, inspects medical history records, searches clinical trial databases, recommends specialists, and prepares draft prescription regimens.

rubricDimensions.requirement: Speech-to-Text with medical lexicon + OCR for past laboratory reports.
Short-term consultation buffer + Long-term HIPAA patient EHR history + Vector DB for clinical guidelines.
Manager-Worker orchestration (Medical Triage Manager delegating to History, Guideline, and Scheduling workers).
Strict PII/HIPAA redaction + Mandatory Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) licensed doctor sign-off before any medical advice or prescription dispatch.
Graceful degradation if guideline API is unavailable, circuit breakers, and audit logging (HATL).
